# Agenda (`agenda`)

Upcoming calendar events grouped by day: all-day chips, timed rows with a colour bar.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAgenda` (types in `dist/web/home/agenda.d.ts`): `.mh-agenda`: upcoming events grouped by day. Each `__day` has a `__day-label` heading, then all-day events as `__chips` (`__chip`, `--c1` to `--c6`) and timed events as `__events` rows (`__event`, `--c1` to `--c6`) with a coloured `__bar`, a `__time` (`__start`, `__end`) and `__body` (`__title`, `__location`). `__empty` when there is nothing, `__more` when `max` cut the list.

```ts
export function createAgenda(options: AgendaOptions): AgendaHandle;

export interface AgendaOptions {
  days: readonly AgendaDay[];
  /** Shown when there are no events (default "Nothing planned"). */
  empty?: string;
  /** Most events shown, counted in display order; the rest are summed up in a "n more" line. */
  max?: number;
  /** Level of the day headings (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  labels?: Partial<AgendaLabels>;
}

export interface AgendaHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: AgendaOptions): void;
}

export interface AgendaLabels {
  /** Spoken before an all-day event's title. */
  allDay: string;
  /** Spoken between start and end. */
  to: string;
  /** The line under a cut-off list. */
  more: (count: number) => string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAgenda, type AgendaDay } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const days: AgendaDay[] = [
  {
    label: 'Today',
    events: [
      { time: null, title: 'Bin day', color: 4 },
      { time: '08:30', end: '09:00', title: 'School run', color: 2 },
      { time: '12:15', end: '13:00', title: 'Lunch with Robin', location: 'Bramblewick Café', color: 1 },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Thu 17 Oct',
    events: [{ time: '10:00', end: '11:30', title: 'Boiler service', location: 'Home' }],
  },
];

// Shows the first five events and sums up the rest.
const agenda = createAgenda({ days, max: 5 });

document.body.append(agenda.el);
```

## React API

`Agenda` (types in `dist/react/home.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createAgenda`.

```ts
export function Agenda({ days, empty = 'Nothing planned', max, headingLevel = 3, labels, className }: AgendaProps);

export interface AgendaProps extends AgendaOptions {
  className?: string;
}
```

    events: [{ time: '10:00', end: '11:30', title: 'Boiler service', location: 'Home' }],
